label: MRtrix3 amp2response
description:
Estimate response function coefficients based on the DWI signal in single-fibre voxels

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: isotropic
parameters.description: estimate an isotropic response function (lmax=0 for all shells)
parameters.usage: estimate an isotropic response function (lmax=0 for all shells) Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: noconstraint
parameters.description: disable the non-negativity and monotonicity constraints
parameters.usage: disable the non-negativity and monotonicity constraints Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: shells
parameters.description:
specify one or more b-values to use during processing, as a comma-separated list of the desired approximate b-values (b-values are clustered to allow for small deviations). Note that some commands are incompatible with multiple b-values, and will report an error if more than one b-value is provided. 
WARNING: note that, even though the b=0 volumes are never referred to as shells in the literature, they still have to be explicitly included in the list of b-values as provided to the -shell option! Several algorithms which include the b=0 volumes in their computations may otherwise return an undesired result.

parameters.label: lmax
parameters.description: specify the maximum harmonic degree of the response function to estimate (can be a comma-separated list for multi-shell data)
parameters.usage: specify the maximum harmonic degree of the response function to estimate (can be a comma-separated list for multi-shell data)  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

input_slots.label: mask
input_slots.description: the mask containing the voxels from which to estimate the response function

input_slots.label: directions
input_slots.description: a 4D image containing the estimated fibre directions

input_slots.label: option_directions
input_slots.description: provide an external text file containing the directions along which the amplitudes are sampled

output_slots.label: response
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Estimate response function coefficients based on the DWI signal in single-fibre voxels
